scope: Paired actual-player 660-frame main stair ascent/descent with fresh phase. No GPU. Reference top is highest FrontSide triangle across production stairs/timber/paving and actual terrain chunks. Skin clearance is exact at the selected vertices and sampled frames, not a continuous collision proof. Source includes unchanged support implementation. Contact markers/support and IK audit values are rounded to0.1mm; joint positions and trace clocks/pins are unrounded. Finite differences at60Hz are observations, not anatomical or artistic acceptance limits. Here both variants use unchanged production4dcf/default cadence. Candidate uses only the isolated raised heel guard plus diagnostic surface counters. All recorded unmodified source inputs, control and geometry hashes match the saved production baseline; helper/driver/intentional override hashes are recorded separately.

labels.candidate: Production4dcf, isolated rigid heel contour guard
